observations: Three photos show two headlamps wrapped in clear plastic, placed on a tiled floor.
The headlamps appear to be for a passenger vehicle, with a black housing and clear lens.
Each headlamp has a main round bulb, a smaller bulb below it, and an amber turn signal on the outer edge.
Photo 0 and photo 2 are identical, showing both headlamps side by side with a person's feet in sandals visible.
Photo 1 shows a single headlamp from a front angle, with bubble wrap and other packaging materials around it.
No visible brand or model markings are readable on the headlamps themselves in any photo.
The seller's text claims 'All head lamp Mitsubishi motors available', but no model or part number is visible in the photos.
